layers.name: Crawl
layers.title: The Draft
layers.text:
It is a dark time for the free world. Deep in the jungles of Vietnam, the Vietkong have hatched their most fiendish plot yet.

While on a completely unrelated experiment with LSD to see about it's medical uses and ability to improve the brains cognitive functions our scientists credible information to suggest that the Vietkong are planning to commit 911 roughly 50 years into the future.

That is where you come in. We wanted the best and got the hero we deserve. Uncle Sam has drafted every able body in the Trailor Park, and found you to be some how more able than the rest.

You got a C. on his physical. You got a B. on your IQ test. Your cholesterol should be studied and your blood sugar is 50/50. You are a specimen of specimen and you are,

BOB

one more thing....

layers.name: Last line
layers.text: Bob, only you can stop the Vietkong from doing 911 in 50 years!

13,33.text: Go into the side room to prepare

12,19.text: Make it to the draft office

np1l3g43.speaker: Bridge Troll
np1l3g43.text: If you wish to Pass you must tell me a funny Joke! Only then will you get Karma! So! What's your funniest Joke!?

n204lpf8.speaker: Bridge Troll
n204lpf8.text: Hmm I don't like where this one's going, Try again!

n0a0y6mj.speaker: Bridge Troll
n0a0y6mj.text: Did you say Six? I'm listening...

nuc4g9ap.speaker: Bridge Troll
nuc4g9ap.text: Nine? Hmmm, I don't think any Jokes start with nine but i'll let you keep going.

nmsfrqgn.speaker: Bridge Troll
nmsfrqgn.text: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! MY GUTS!!! MY GOD!!!! HAHAAHAHAHAHAHAHA YOU ARE SO FREAKING FUNNY! YOU MAY PASS MY PAL PASS PASS PASS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! AHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA

choices.text: Thank you, thank you! I'll be here all night!

nu9xiqmg.speaker: Bridge Troll
nu9xiqmg.text: Nine, One? I don't understand. Why, i've never heard this one before....

nw937n93.speaker: Bob
nw937n93.text: Hi, my name is Bob based and i'm an alcoholic

nxk6qcg3.speaker: SUPERBOB
nxk6qcg3.text: HALT EVIL VILLIAN. YOUR DAYS OF VILLIANY ARE OVER

choices.text: YOU THINK YOU CAN DEFEAT ME!? SUPER BOB! IT IS YOU WHO WILL BE DEFEATED!

nfwhdjgn.speaker: SUPERBOB
nfwhdjgn.text: HOW DO YOU KNOW THAT NAME!!!

nrf3noz2.speaker: DK
nrf3noz2.text: Oh why didn't you just say so! Show me whatcha got!

npjudvkr.speaker: Evil Shop Keep
npjudvkr.text: I will turn you into a coin!

choices.text: Hope I end up worth a lot.

ndlgbby1a.speaker: Earl
ndlgbby1a.text: They pulled the numbers on TV last night. My birthday came up first. Number one.

ndlgbby1b.speaker: Earl
ndlgbby1b.text: Lucky like a squirrel in a dog park.

ndlgbby1c.speaker: Earl
ndlgbby1c.text: See you over there, then. Save me a spot in the foxhole.

ndlgbby1d.speaker: Earl
ndlgbby1d.text: Thanks. Uncle Sam is getting me a helmet.

choices.text: Didn't I see you at a weather balloon?

ndlgclk1b.speaker: Clerk
ndlgclk1b.text: Okay... Okay... here you are. Classification 1-A. Congratulations, Mr. Okay. Uncle Sam wants you.

ndlgclk1d.speaker: Clerk
ndlgclk1d.text: Available for military service. 4-F is unfit. You are not 4-F. I can tell from here.

ndlgclk1g.speaker: Clerk
ndlgclk1g.text: The Army has boots for that.

ndlgclk1e.speaker: Clerk
ndlgclk1e.text: You had a choice. It was a lottery. Your birthday came up.

ndlgclk1f.speaker: Clerk
ndlgclk1f.text: Sign here, here and here. Then see the Sergeant in the back for your physical. Next!

ndlgcnd1a.speaker: Dale
ndlgcnd1a.text: Psst. I'm not really waiting. My car's running out front. Canada is nice this time of year.

ndlgcnd1b.speaker: Dale
ndlgcnd1b.text: No room. The car is full of my mom's casseroles.

ndlgcnd1c.speaker: Dale
ndlgcnd1c.text: You're alright, Bob. Here, take my lunch. I won't need it up north.

ndlgord1a.speaker: Notice
ndlgord1a.text: ORDER TO REPORT FOR INDUCTION. Greeting: You are hereby ordered for induction into the Armed Forces of the United States.

choices.text: (Open the cage) Go on, get out of here.

ndlgprt1a.speaker: Protester
ndlgprt1a.text: Hell no, we won't go! ...Are you going in there, man?

ndlgprt1b.speaker: Protester
ndlgprt1b.text: Bummer. Here, take a flower. Peace, man.

ndlgprt1c.speaker: Protester
ndlgprt1c.text: The Man has the only toilet on this block, man.

ndlgprt1d.speaker: Protester
ndlgprt1d.text: Violence is never the answer! ...Unless you started it.

ndlgrob1a.speaker: Rusty
ndlgrob1a.text: They told me to turn my head and cough. That was an hour ago. Nobody came back.

ndlgrob1c.speaker: Rusty
ndlgrob1c.text: Same place as yours will be in about five minutes.

ndlgsgt1a.speaker: Sergeant
ndlgsgt1a.text: You the new one? Read me the bottom line of that chart, recruit.

choices.text: I'd like to see a doctor.

ndlgsgt1b.speaker: Sergeant
ndlgsgt1b.text: Twenty-twenty. Step on the scale. Six foot two and breathing. You pass.

ndlgsgt1c.speaker: Sergeant
ndlgsgt1c.text: The big one with the letters on it. Never mind. You pass. The Army needs bodies, not eyes.

ndlgsgt1d.speaker: Sergeant
ndlgsgt1d.text: I am the doctor today. Say ahh.

ndlgsgt1e.speaker: Sergeant
ndlgsgt1e.text: Your ride is out back. When the bird comes down, grab the rope and hang on. Next stop, the jungle.

choices.text: Can I get a weapon first?

ndlgsgt1f.speaker: Sergeant
ndlgsgt1f.text: You'll get one when you land. Now move it, private!

ndlgvcega.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcega.text: Do not touch anything. Especially the drum. Especially the OTHER drum. You are here about the launch?

choices.text: Is that rocket made of bamboo?

ndlgvcegb.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegb.text: Bamboo is light, strong, and grows back by Tuesday. Steel does not grow back by Tuesday.

ndlgvcege.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcege.text: Heat shield. My grandmother wove it. If it can keep off the monsoon, it can keep off space.

ndlgvcegc.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegc.text: The Moon. VC-0 went into the hill, but VC-0 was a test. VC-1 has more fuel. Much, much more fuel.

ndlgvcegf.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegf.text: The monkey. The man by the monkey THINKS it is him. Do not tell him.

ndlgvcegg.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegg.text: The plunger is out by the pad. When the countdown is done, someone must push it. Not me. I have a family.

ndlgvcegd.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegd.text: Then you will have to get past the whole ministry of rockets. GUARDS!

ndlgvcpla.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcpla.text: I was VOLUNTEERED. First human on the Moon! They are training me with the monkey. The monkey is doing very well.

choices.text: Want to get out of here?

ndlgvcplb.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcplb.text: He has done forty launches in the cage. I haven't done any, yet. He is the senior pilot.

ndlgvcplc.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcplc.text: Thank you! Take my rations. They'll just give them to the monkey anyway.

ndlgvcpld.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcpld.text: ...Yes. Yes I do. I will cover you. Let the monkey have the Moon.

ndlgvcqma.speaker: Quartermaster
ndlgvcqma.text: The program buys only the best. From the Americans, mostly. They leave it lying around.

ndlgvcsga.speaker: Sign
ndlgvcsga.text: PEOPLE'S SPACE PROGRAM. RESTRICTED AREA. The Americans have their NASA. We have bamboo, and the Moon is closer from the jungle.

n7jbz7t8.speaker: Agent
n7jbz7t8.text: Move along, citizen. Nothing to see here. That is a weather balloon.

n6xw9n4l.speaker: Agent
n6xw9n4l.text: It is a weather balloon. Look into this light for me, please.

nhm9pxdg.speaker: Agent
nhm9pxdg.text: The United States Government thanks you for not asking questions.

choices.text: I wasn't asking a question. I was asking for it.

n87k9bfd.speaker: Agent
n87k9bfd.text: *FLASH* You saw a weather balloon. You are going to the draft office. Have a nice day, Bob.

njqf2r5l.speaker: Agent
njqf2r5l.text: I was afraid you'd say that.

n93mn5n5.speaker: Harembe
n93mn5n5.text: Hi, Welcome to Zoobob, my name is Harembe I will be your tour guide today.

choices.text: I'm excited to take a look around the place.

nj4ws3ld.speaker: Harembe
nj4ws3ld.text: Hmm not likely. There making some "Holy Bible 2" book about me but it's not out yet.

choices.text: I see. I think i'm gonna tour on my own.
May you please show me what you have collected in your travels great Harembe?
I am ready to start the tour.

n5vtqw2b.speaker: The Shop Keeper
n5vtqw2b.text: Welcome welcome come see my wares

nvhwh6vy.speaker: Chaplin
nvhwh6vy.text: Greetings Mere Mortal, I am the Chaplin! Knower of all and bringer of destruction!

choices.text: I am honored to make your aquantance.
I'll just be on my way then.

ns2pkxhf.speaker: Chaplin
ns2pkxhf.text: I am the Omega and the Alpha. Begining and end. I am the one blessed with Nine lives, do you know what that makes me? IMMORTAL! For as a cat chases a Mouse you are my prey stupid Human.

choices.text: Very well then. Prepare to die!

ntapp656.speaker: Chaplin
ntapp656.text: I am the supreme being which the other supreme beings cower when they here the name! It is not of mice and men for the Mice have been devoured and the Men entranced and enslaved! Mwahahahahaha!

choices.text: There is no greater Idol, I worship thee and ask for nothing.
Why Great Supreme being may you please bestow a Miracle upon me and heal my wounds?
I only believe in one Supreme being and he doesn't have Wiskers!

nzxao33m.speaker: Chaplin
nzxao33m.text: Your flattery wins no favor among the gods! It is but a mere expectation!

choices.text: Okay can we please cut the crap you're clearly just a guy wearing a Cat hat.
I merely wish to show how grateful I am to be in your presence. Perhaps an exchange of presents?
I do not require your favor as I am not worthy. It is your Grace that honors me.

nci8yzvd.speaker: Chaplin
nci8yzvd.text: I see. There is great Glory and many Honorifics in your future. Perhaps I can accompany you in these trying times?

choices.text: I would be honored to have you by my side
I'm actually more of a Dog person

nfvc0qvn.speaker: Ash Kechmeoutside
nfvc0qvn.text: You may have gotten past my Pokemans but you'll never get past me!

nnrf0.speaker: Nerf Trainer
nnrf0.text: Heard they called you to Nam! Hope you remember what I taught you bout shootin! use the Arrow Keys to aim, press F to shoot, and press R to reload. Just make sure your enemy is in range!.

choices.text: What does Q do when holding a gun?

nnrf1.speaker: Nerf Trainer
nnrf1.text: Pressing Q strikes up close with your gun! If you press Q right into an enemy's melee attack, you'll parry and shove each other back, pressing Q into an incoming projectile swats it right out of the air!

choices.text: Got it, give me a second.

nnrf2.speaker: Nerf Trainer
nnrf2.text: Lock and load! Aim with the Arrows, fire with F, watch your range, or swat my foam darts away with Q!

nngwaggl.speaker: Fanatic
nngwaggl.text: We have to build a wall to keep the Aliens out!

choices.text: "Aliens" is offensive they prefer extra terrestrials.

nswd0.speaker: Sword Trainer
nswd0.text: They got you headin to Nam? Best learn how to swing a machete! When holding a melee weapon, press F to swing at enemies, press Q to raise your guard and block incoming melee attacks!

choices.text: What if someone shoots at me in Vietnam (Or on the way to the draft office)?
Hold on, I'll be right back.

nswd1.speaker: Sword Trainer
nswd1.text: Good question! Blocking with Q stops melee blows, and swinging your melee weapon with F right into an incoming projectile swats it out of the air! Time your Q blocks and F swings. want to try it on me?

nswd2.speaker: Sword Trainer
nswd2.text: En garde! Block my strike with Q and strike back with F!

ntv0.speaker: TV
ntv0.text:
This just in: 
WASD to move. 
Space Bar to jump.
Clothes in the Closet, Guns in the Kitchen.
In other news: Bob has been drafted to Vietnam!
